title: Jazzy Algerian Ti-Leaf Wrap
description: A comforting Algerian dish featuring a flaky ti-leaf wrap filled with a rich egg yolk mixture, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This flexitarian-friendly recipe is easy to make and packed with flavor.
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together egg yolks, olive oil, garlic, ginger, cumin, paprika, and salt until smooth.
Add the warm water to the egg yolk mixture and mix until well combined.
Heat a ti-leaf wrap in a dry skillet over medium heat for 30 seconds on each side.
Place the ti-leaf wrap on a flat surface and spread the egg yolk mixture evenly over the center of the wrap.
Fold the bottom half of the ti-leaf wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap into a tight cylinder.
Repeat with the remaining ingredients and serve hot.
Serve immediately, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
This recipe makes 4-6 wraps, depending on serving size.
You can also add other fillings such as crumbled feta cheese or chopped cooked vegetables to the egg yolk mixture for added flavor.
Be sure to handle the egg yolks gently to avoid scrambling them.
If you prefer a crisper wrap, you can cook the ti-leaf wraps in a dry skillet for an additional 1-2 minutes on each side prior to filling and rolling.
